items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: I was with Zutty Singleton... And Don Fry, Don Fry, Don Fry pianist. Yeah, I remember. He's still there, I heard. She's been there for many years.

ctx.x: So, when I first went in, Jimmy Ryan, Jimmy Ryan wasn't anything about, uh, it just was a little, little place. Yeah. Wasn't known at all. We, we made it popular then. It was Zutty Singleton. Oh, yeah. I was with Zutty Singleton. Oh, yeah. And Joe Elridge, uh, Roy Elridge, uh, brother. That's right. Yeah. Yeah. And Don Fry, Don Fry, Don Fry pianist. Yeah, I remember. He's still there, I heard. She's been there for many years.
I first heard him at Missouri down at the Vanguard.
